 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2023-CV-0044
 Lindsey Walker, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
9-28-23
Counsel for defendant:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant, for its answer to Plaintiff's Original Petition, respectfully shows the Court as follows.
Pursuant to Rule 92 of the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure, Defendant generally denies each and every allegation
contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict proof thereof by a preponderance of the credible evidence.
For its first affirmative defense, Defendant asserts proportionate responsibility unedr Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil
Practice and Remedies Code. Plaintiff's own failure to keep a proper lookout and to yield the right-of-way at the
intersection caused or contributed to the collision, and any recovery must be reduced accordingly or barred if
Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility exceeds fifty percent.
For its second affirmative defense, Defendant asserts sudden emergency. Immediately before the impact, a vehicle
entered the intersection at speed and without warning, leaving Defendant no reasonable time to react, and Defendant
acted as an ordinarily prudent driver would under the same circumstances.
For its third affirmative defense, Defendant asserts failure to mitigate damages. Plaintiff failed to use reasonable care
to obtain prompt and appropriate medical treatment and to follow recommended care, and any damages that
reasonable mitigation would have avoided are not recoverable.
Defendant reserves the right to amend this answer as discovery proceeds.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
